g.text: ANLI test (3,200 inputs, retrospective) · one L40S · 3 repeats × 120 s per tested rate · requests arriving in the 120 s window and answered correctly within their own SLO, ÷ 120 s

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: Each group is one tested rate; the deployments are offset inside it only for legibility, and the grey bar marks the offered rate. With three repeats, the large marker (median)

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: and the two whisker ends (min, max) are the three measured values. A marker is filled when every repeat answered at least 99% of offers within the SLO; no other rate was measured.

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: StartLux-4B at 20/s keeps its r0 repeat (96.9% on time at 500 ms, 97.2% at 1,000 ms), whose 78 late answers came from requests scheduled within a 3.6 s span. GPU shares differ by deployment.
